name: Adaptive beta-geometric correction (experimental)
description: Searches positive-count trimming fractions for the smallest maximum geometric-quantile discrepancy; preserves zeros; optional explicit final TTR.
formula: choose f minimizing max_r((corrected_r-geometric_quantile_r)^2/geometric_quantile_r); fit positive counts only
may_suit: Sensitivity option for skewed counts when a geometric target and adaptive distribution-based fitting are appropriate.
caution: The score is not a p-value or biological validation. Tail convention and grid affect selection; can compress real effects; invalid candidates are reported, not silently replaced.
